name: Reborn of The Rightful
overview: After dying with her enemies, Ren Yaoqi is reborn five years in the past and seizes her second chance to change her fate. By carefully plotting to protect her family and relying on her own strength, she forms an equal partnership with Xiao Jingxi, and together they work to secure peace for the people and a future she once lost.
